import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap, cost;
        Edge rev;

        public Edge(int _src, int _dst, long _cap, long _cost, Edge _rev) {
            src = _src;
            dst = _dst;
            cap = _cap;
            cost = _cost;
            rev = _rev;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int n;
        long minCost, totalCost;
        long[] supp;
        long[] ptnl;
        Edge[][] adj;

        public MinCostFlow(int _n) {
            n = _n;
            supp = new long[n];
            ptnl = new long[n];
            adj = new Edge[n][];
        }

        public void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            adj[src] = Arrays.copyOf(adj[src], adj[src].length + 1);
            adj[src][adj[src].length - 1] = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
            adj[dst] = Arrays.copyOf(adj[dst], adj[dst].length + 1);
            adj[dst][adj[dst].length - 1] = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null);
            adj[src][adj[src].length - 1].rev = adj[dst][adj[dst].length - 1];
            adj[dst][adj[dst].length - 1].rev = adj[src][adj[src].length - 1];
        }

        public void supply(int node, long vol) {
            supp[node] += vol;
        }

        public boolean flow() {
            for (boolean aug = true; aug; ) {
                aug = false;
                Edge[] last = new Edge[n];
                Dijkstra(last);
                boolean[] shut = new boolean[n];
                for (int dst = 0; dst < n; ++dst) {
                    if (supp[dst] < 0 && last[dst] != null) {
                        long resid = -supp[dst];
                        int src = dst, block;
                        block = -1;
                        while (last[src] != null && !shut[src]) {
                            if (resid >= last[src].cap) resid = last[block = src].cap;
                            src = last[src].src;
                        }
                        if (shut[src]) block = src;
                        else {
                            if (resid >= supp[src]) {
                                resid = supp[src];
                                block = src;
                            }
                            for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                                last[node].cap -= resid;
                                last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                            }
                            supp[src] -= resid;
                            supp[dst] += resid;
                            minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                            aug = true;
                        }
                        if (block != -1) {
                            for (int node = dst; node != block; node = last[node].src) shut[node] = true;
                            shut[block] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (long s : supp) if (s > 0) return false;
            return true;
        }

        public long optimal() {
            assert(flow());
            return minCost;
        }

        public void Dijkstra(Edge[] last) {
            long[] dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            PriorityQueue<Pair> que = new PriorityQueue<>();
            for (int node = 0; node < n; ++node) {
                if (supp[node] > 0) {
                    dist[node] = 0;
                    que.add(new Pair(0, node));
                }
            }
            while (!que.isEmpty()) {
                Pair pair = que.poll();
                long nsp = -pair.value;
                int node = pair.index;
                if (nsp != dist[node]) continue;
                ptnl[node] -= nsp;
                if (ptnl[node] > Long.MAX_VALUE) ptnl[node] = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                dist[node] = -1;
                for (Edge e : adj[node]) {
                    if (dist[e.dst] == Long.MAX_VALUE || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    if (dist[e.dst] > ptnl[node] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst]) {
                        dist[e.dst] = ptnl[node] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                        last[e.dst] = e;
                        que.add(new Pair(-dist[e.dst], e.dst));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        public MinCostFlow(int _n) {
            this(_n);
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
        }

        public MinCostFlow(MinCostFlow other) {
            this(other.n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                supp[i] = other.supp[i];
                ptnl[i] = other.ptnl[i];
                adj[i] = Arrays.copyOf(other.adj[i], other.adj[i].length);
            }
        }

        public MinCostFlow(MinCostFlow other) {
            this(other.n);
            copyMember(other);
        }

        public void copyMember(MinCostFlow other) {
            minCost = other.minCost;
            totalCost = other.totalCost;
            supp = Arrays.copyOf(other.supp, other.supp.length);
            ptnl = Arrays.copyOf(other.ptnl, other.ptnl.length);
        }
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long value;
        int index;

        public Pair(long value, int index) {
            this.value = value;
            this.index = index;
        }

        public int compareTo(Pair other) {
            return Long.compare(value, other.value);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int tlim = 105;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; ++t) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; ++x) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; ++t) mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
